answer: For disputes over a pearl report, mesa survey or pigment analysis, use a permissioned jury. A trusted registrar audits seven suppliers' beneficial ownership and pins one signing key per independent controller. The ledger pays each escrow once, requiring five distinct pinned keys to sign the same escrow ID and payout. Ten thousand fresh aliases add no authority; an attacker must corrupt or steal five enrolled keys. Safety depends on honest enrollment, secure signatures and fewer than five colluding jurors.
